RELATION_TO_THE_EXISTING_CORE: this is a SUPPLEMENT to FDFLT01_RAW_CORE.tar.zst (sha256 936fac7c7d61df1a1bedf2d94e5e933930aa55f66de2e057e41202b467f04467, already durable on the Windows disk), which carries the X plane at every step and every non-field array. Together they are analysis-sufficient.
WHAT_THIS_ADDS: the six-species occupancy and the free capacity at EVERY Y-occupied cell at EVERY step, plus the frozen centre label of that cell. This is what makes the X birth probability min(1, kX*nX*nY) and the X candidate pool min(nSX, free) evaluable at the cells where X is actually produced.
NO_FIELD_INVENTED: every stored column is read directly from the reconstructed archive; no value is modelled or imputed
